name: חֲשַׁבְנָה
summary: One of the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's day (Neh 10:26). The name is formed from חָשַׁב and looks like a short form of Hashabneiah, “Yahweh has regarded me”, without the divine name; the ending is not clear. Scripture does not explain it.
note: Takes h.gr.ai (1 token). TIPNR's Hashabnah@Neh.10.25 is Neh 10:26 in the Hebrew. The ending ‑nah is uncertain (a short form of חֲשַׁבְנְיָה, or a noun with ‑ān); a reading of the form only.
